name: CrewAI
summary: One Agent (the system prompt as its backstory), one Task, one Crew; MCP tools from crewai-tools' MCPServerAdapter and Claude through CrewAI's native Anthropic provider.
notes: MCP uses MCPServerAdapter, not the Agent's newer mcps= field: mcps= names each tool '<host_port_path>_<tool>' and truncates to 64 chars with a hash, so on the lab's long URLs every MCP tool reached Claude as 'mcp_127_0_0_1_7804_mcp_<run>_<agent>_fil_7ef4a70f' (real name lost; it also opens a new MCP session per call). CrewAI adds 'You are {role}.' and 'Your personal goal is: …' to the system prompt (+85 chars), wraps the task in 'Current Task: …' plus 'you MUST return the actual complete content as the final answer, not a summary' (+181 chars, so the final answer tends to be the whole memo rather than the asked-for summary), sends stop_sequences ['\nObservation:'], marks tool schemas strict:true, puts cache_control on the system prompt and first user message only, and drops the assistant's text and thinking blocks from the history it resends. No temperature or forced tool_choice is sent, so no shims. crewai pins mcp<2 and anthropic~=0.73. crewai imports chromadb unconditionally; chromadb 1.5.9 has open advisories with no fixed release, all in Chroma's HTTP server, which the lab never starts (see SECURITY.md).
